title: NVIDIA at Consumer Electronics Show (CES) 2025
reading: A single photo of an NVIDIA CES 2025 keynote fills the slide, showing the presenter on stage in front of a large screen displaying NVIDIA's staged view of AI's evolution. The slide itself carries no body text beyond the title, so the content is carried entirely by the captured keynote graphic.

visuals.description: Photo of a keynote stage screen with an upward-curving green arrow annotated with four successive stages: '2012 ALEXNET' at the origin, then PERCEPTION AI (speech recognition, medical imaging), GENERATIVE AI (digital marketing, content creation), AGENTIC AI (coding assistant, customer service, patient care), and PHYSICAL AI (self-driving cars, general robotics) at the top right. A speaker stands in silhouette at the lower left.
visuals.assertion: AI has progressed through exponentially escalating waves — perception, generative, agentic — with physical AI (robotics and autonomous vehicles) as the next frontier.

concepts.name: Perception AI
concepts.why_it_matters: First wave, dating from AlexNet 2012, covering recognition tasks.

concepts.name: Generative AI
concepts.why_it_matters: Second wave producing content rather than only classifying.

concepts.name: Agentic AI
concepts.why_it_matters: AI systems that act on tasks such as coding or customer service.

concepts.name: Physical AI
concepts.why_it_matters: NVIDIA's framing of the next wave: embodied AI in robots and vehicles.
